top_3_research_highlights.finding: SQM is already a FlytBase user via Adentu, achieving 4x yield improvements and 95% mission reliability [S42].
top_3_research_highlights.why_ae_should_care: This is an expansion play, not a cold acquisition; leverage existing internal success to bypass technical skepticism.

top_3_research_highlights.finding: SQM expects US$3B in CAPEX (2026-2028) and is heavily invested in 'Salar Futuro' sustainability goals [S6, S26].
top_3_research_highlights.why_ae_should_care: Align the proposal with 'Salar Futuro' to frame the drone solution as a sustainability and efficiency imperative.

top_3_research_highlights.finding: SQM reported a 353.5% increase in net income for H1 2026 [S11, S32].
top_3_research_highlights.why_ae_should_care: Strong financial health suggests high capacity to fund operational efficiency projects in Q3.
